data.name: Fiora Mara
data.description: Fiora Mara is an early-stage New York–based marine CDR startup founded in 2024 that builds biodegradable seaweed farms designed to auto-sink matured kelp biomass to the deep ocean for long-term carbon sequestration. The company emerged from the ClimateBase Fellowship and has participated in AirMiners Launchpad and VentureWell accelerators, operating a seaweed hatchery and pilot farm with the RETI Center. It plans to sell carbon credits from sunk seaweed biomass.
